method: Re-derived from sources rather than from the target's own summary: corpus/grammar/{n3,n4,n5}.json, corpus/vocab/*.json, corpus/sentences/bank.json (raw bytes, not just parsed), the two source queues, research/datasets/tatoeba/{jpn,eng}_sentences.tsv.bz2 and links.tar.bz2, research/derived/fable5_validation/verified_reading_overrides.json, scripts/validate/validate.py, scripts/ingest/dissect.py, and a fresh run of the project's own dissector (.venv SudachiPy 0.6.11 + sudachidict_full against db/corpus.sqlite) on all 15 stored and proposed strings.

anchors.notes: All 7 gram:you-da anchors are byte-exact against corpus/grammar/n4.json (4 whole-field, 2 substrings of explanation, 1 canonical json.dumps of the register array). All 19 sentence anchors occur byte-exact in the raw bytes of corpus/sentences/bank.json. The expl_pt anchor was correctly extended one character to the left relative to the source queue; without that leading space the deletion would leave a trailing space.

fixes_are_values.notes: No fix value contains an instruction verb, an arrow, an em dash, or an emoji. Empty fixes occur only on needs-human rows.

locale_purity.notes: pt-BR fixes are pt-BR, en fixes are en, the register fix is neutral English (['plain','written'], an existing 16-record combination).

layer_a.notes: Tatoeba 141147 and 223377 jp confirmed byte-identical to jpn_sentences.tsv.bz2 and untouched. No sent:gen- jp/kana/romaji/token surface is modified by any fix, so no jp-to-kana/romaji/token/translation desync is possible.

problems.issue: The defect is real (the stored en paraphrases and drops 入った, which the pt-BR sibling renders) and the anchor is byte-exact, but the replacement adopts an interlinear hyphen-gloss format that appears in 0 of 5,889 translation_literal.en values in corpus/sentences/bank.json, against 1,670 that open with 'As for'. The format exists on the pt-BR side (68 records, including this record's sibling), so the row buys within-record parity at the cost of being the only en literal in the corpus written that way. A convention-preserving value that still renders 入った was available.
